system.description: A candle stub from the Candle-Wicked Men's first vigil. Once per day, light it: for 1 hour it sheds light 30', and Undead and Duskborn that enter or start their turn in its light take d6 damage. Expendable d20.
system.lastRite: ◈ Snap the wick: for 10 rounds it sheds light 60', and every Undead and Duskborn that starts its turn in the light takes 2d6 damage and is Frightened of you.
system.drawback: You are Frightened of complete darkness until it is recovered.
system.faction: the Solemn Order of the Candle-Wicked Men
